Heat the oven to 220C, spread the filling in a baking dish, cover with the mash and rough up the top with a fork.
Sprinkle with parmesan and bake 30-35 minutes until golden; rest 10 minutes before serving with green veg.

title: Healthy turkey chili

ingredients.text: 265 g canned tomatoes, diced or crushed
ingredients.original_text: 795 g canned tomatoes, diced or crushed

ingredients.text: 285 g kidney beans, canned, rinsed and drained
ingredients.original_text: 850 g kidney beans, 2 x 15 oz cans, rinsed and drained

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and cook the onion, garlic and pepper for 5-7 minutes, stirring often.
Add the turkey and break it up with a spoon until it is no longer pink.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, oregano, cayenne and salt and toast for about 20 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, stock, kidney beans and corn and bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer 30-45 minutes until thick, then adjust the seasoning.
Serve topped with a little cheese, avocado or coriander if you like.

title: Irish lamb stew

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp olive oil, or canola oil
ingredients.original_text: 3 tbsp olive oil, or canola oil

ingredients.text: 115 g bell pepper, roasted, from a can, in strips
ingredients.original_text: 340 g bell pepper, roasted, 1 can, in strips

ingredients.text: 150 g rice, or crusty bread, to serve
ingredients.original_text: 450 g rice, or crusty bread, to serve

steps: Toss the lamb with half the garlic, the rosemary and the white wine and leave to marinate for 1 hour; drain and discard the liquid.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot and brown the lamb on all sides in small batches; set aside.
Soften the onion in the same pot for about 4 minutes, then add the remaining garlic for 1 minute.
Return the lamb with the chili flakes, roasted peppers, tomato, bay leaf and red wine; bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes.
Pour in the stock and cook gently on low for 1.5-2 hours until the lamb is very tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with rice or crusty bread.

title: Jerk chicken curry with beans

ingredients.text: 0.5 bunch fresh coriander, stalks chopped, leaves kept
ingredients.original_text: 1 bunch fresh coriander, small, stalks chopped, leaves kept

steps: Rub the drumsticks with a little of the jerk seasoning plus salt and pepper.
Brown them in half the oil, then lift out onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and soften the onion and coriander stalks for about 5 minutes, stirring in the remaining jerk seasoning for the last minute.
Put the chicken back, add the tomatoes, bring to a simmer, cover and cook 20 minutes; start the rice meanwhile.
Uncover, add the beans and simmer 10 minutes more until the chicken is cooked through.
Scatter with coriander leaves and serve with the rice.

title: Jerk chicken with sweet potato fries

ingredients.text: 500 g sweet potato, in finger-thick chips
ingredients.original_text: 500 g sweet potato, in finger-thick chips

ingredients.text: 0.5 tsp chili flakes, or 1 fresh chilli, deseeded
ingredients.original_text: 0.5 tsp chili flakes, or 1 fresh chilli, deseeded

steps: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan) and line two baking trays.
Cut the sweet potatoes into finger-thick chips, toss with most of the oil and a pinch of salt and spread on one tray.
Rub the jerk seasoning into the chicken and lay it on the second tray.
Roast 20 minutes with the chicken on the top shelf and the chips below, then swap the trays and roast 15-20 minutes more until the chips are tender and charred and the chicken is cooked.
Meanwhile mix the tomatoes, onion and chilli with the lime zest, half the lime juice, a drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt.
Serve the chicken and chips with the tomato salad, lamb's lettuce and the rest of the lime in wedges.

title: Lamb kofta with herby yogurt

ingredients.text: 0.5 tbsp fresh mint, chopped, for the kofta
ingredients.original_text: 1 tbsp fresh mint, chopped, for the kofta

ingredients.text: 0.5 tbsp parsley, chopped, for the kofta
ingredients.original_text: 1 tbsp parsley, chopped, for the kofta

ingredients.text: 0.5 clove garlic, finely grated, for the sauce
ingredients.original_text: 1 clove garlic, finely grated, for the sauce

ingredients.text: 0.5 tbsp fresh mint, chopped, for the sauce
ingredients.original_text: 1 tbsp fresh mint, chopped, for the sauce

ingredients.text: 0.5 tbsp parsley, or coriander, for the sauce
ingredients.original_text: 1 tbsp parsley, or coriander, for the sauce

ingredients.text: 0.5 onion, red, pickled or thinly sliced
ingredients.original_text: 1 onion, red, pickled or thinly sliced

steps: Combine the lamb with the garlic, grated onion, spices, herbs, salt and pepper.
Split into 4 portions, press each around a skewer into a long kofta and chill 10-15 minutes if time allows.
Stir the yogurt with the garlic, lemon juice, herbs and seasoning; keep cold.
Heat a grill or barbecue to medium-high and brush the koftas with oil.
Grill 12-15 minutes, turning often, until browned and cooked through (70°C inside).
Serve with warm flatbreads, the yogurt sauce, lettuce, cucumber and red onion.

title: Lebanese chicken shawarma wraps

ingredients.text: 250 g chicken breast, or thighs, boneless skinless, sliced
ingredients.original_text: 500 g chicken breast, or thighs, boneless skinless, sliced

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp olive oil, for the marinade
ingredients.original_text: 2 tbsp olive oil, for the marinade

ingredients.text: 1.5 tbsp olive oil, or neutral oil, for frying
ingredients.original_text: 3 tbsp olive oil, or neutral oil, for frying

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp mayonnaise, or toum (Lebanese garlic sauce)
ingredients.original_text: 4 tbsp mayonnaise, or toum (Lebanese garlic sauce)

steps: Mix the garlic, lemon juice, yogurt, salt, spices and olive oil into a marinade.
Coat the chicken in it and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight (at least 1 hour if pressed).
Heat the frying oil in a wide pan until very hot.
Cook the chicken in a single uncrowded layer, about 2 minutes per side for thin breast slices, until browned and cooked through.
Cut the cooked chicken into strips.
Spread toum down the centre of each pita, add the chicken, pickles and fries if using.
Roll up tightly and halve to serve.

title: Lighter Swedish meatballs
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, add the celery and parsley for a couple of minutes, then let the mix cool.
Combine the turkey, beef, egg, cooled vegetables, breadcrumbs, salt, pepper and allspice; shape into 8 meatballs.
Bring the broth to a boil in a skillet, lower to a simmer and add the meatballs.
Cover and poach about 20 minutes until cooked through, then lift the meatballs out.
Strain the broth and blend it with the cream cheese until smooth.
Return the sauce and meatballs to the skillet and simmer a few minutes until the sauce thickens slightly; garnish with parsley.

title: Lighter chicken paprikash

ingredients.text: 285 g chicken breast, boneless skinless, in pieces
ingredients.original_text: 565 g chicken breast, boneless skinless, in pieces

ingredients.text: 205 g canned tomatoes, diced fire-roasted, with juice
ingredients.original_text: 410 g canned tomatoes, diced fire-roasted, with juice

ingredients.text: 60 g greek yogurt, plain (2% or whole)
ingredients.original_text: 120 g greek yogurt, plain (2% or whole)

ingredients.text: 150 g noodles, egg noodles, to serve
ingredients.original_text: 300 g noodles, egg noodles, to serve

steps: Put a pan of salted water on to boil and cook the egg noodles while you make the sauce.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until no longer pink; lift it out.
Soften the onion in the same pan, then add the garlic for about a minute.
Return the chicken with both paprikas, the stock, tomatoes, salt and pepper; bring to a boil and cook about 2 minutes until a little thicker.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the yogurt (off the heat so it doesn't split); adjust the seasoning.
Spoon over the noodles and finish with parsley.

title: Moroccan chicken tagine with olives and lemon

ingredients.text: 900 g chicken thigh, bone-in skin-on pieces
ingredients.original_text: 1800 g chicken thigh, bone-in skin-on pieces (4 lb)

ingredients.text: 70 g olives, green cracked, pitted and halved
ingredients.original_text: 140 g olives, green cracked, pitted and halved (1 cup)

steps: Mix most of the garlic with all the ground spices; finely chop one zest strip and mix it with the remaining garlic.
Pat the chicken dry, season, and brown it well in hot oil in a heavy pot, in batches; set aside.
Pour off most of the fat, then soften the onion with the remaining zest strips.
Stir in the spice paste for about 30 seconds, then add carrots, stock and honey, scraping the pot.
Return the chicken and juices, cover and simmer gently until tender, about 1 hour for thighs (add breast pieces only for the last 20 minutes).
Lift out the chicken and keep warm; skim the sauce, add the olives and simmer until slightly thickened and the carrots are soft.
Put the chicken back, stir in the garlic-zest mix, coriander and lemon juice, adjust seasoning and serve.

title: Peruvian roast chicken with green sauce

ingredients.text: 1.5 tbsp olive oil, for the marinade
ingredients.original_text: 3 tbsp olive oil, for the marinade

ingredients.text: 900 g chicken thigh, i.e. a small whole chicken or half a large one
ingredients.original_text: 1800 g chicken thigh, i.e. a whole chicken (4 lb)
30 g fresh coriander, leaves (1 cup packed)

ingredients.text: 0.5 tbsp lime, juice, for the sauce
ingredients.original_text: 1 tbsp lime, juice, for the sauce

ingredients.text: 1 pinch black pepper, for the sauce
ingredients.original_text: 0.125 tsp black pepper, for the sauce

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp olive oil, for the sauce
ingredients.original_text: 2 tbsp olive oil, for the sauce

steps: Blitz the marinade ingredients (oil, lime juice, garlic, salt, spices, oregano, sugar) until smooth.
Dry the chicken, loosen the skin over breast and legs, push most of the marinade underneath and rub the rest outside.
Refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.
Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) with a rack low-middle; set the chicken on an oiled rack over a foil-lined pan and tie the legs.
Roast 20 minutes until golden, then lower to 190°C (375°F) and roast until the juices run clear (about 70 minutes for a 1.8 kg bird, less for a smaller one); tent with foil if browning too fast.
Blend jalapeños, coriander, garlic, mayonnaise, sour cream, lime juice, salt and pepper, then stream in the oil with the motor running; chill to thicken.
Rest the chicken under foil about 20 minutes, carve and serve with the green sauce.

title: Seared harissa salmon with cauliflower and chickpeas

ingredients.original_text: 50 g olives, green pitted, quartered (1/3 cup)

steps: Stir the harissa and honey together; set aside.
In a large bowl toss the chickpeas with part of the oil, the lemon juice and the shallot.
Cook the cauliflower with most of the ground coriander, half the salt and more oil in a covered nonstick skillet until starting to soften, then uncover and cook until spotty brown.
Add the cauliflower to the chickpeas with the olives, coriander and mint; keep warm and wipe out the pan.
Season the salmon with the rest of the coriander and salt and sear it, skinned side up, in the remaining oil until deeply browned.
Flip and cook until the centre reaches about 50°C (125°F) for medium-rare.
Off the heat brush the fillets with the harissa-honey, re-toss the vegetables, season and serve together.

title: Sherry-braised chicken with chorizo and chickpeas

ingredients.text: 125 g bell pepper, roasted from a jar, thickly sliced
ingredients.original_text: 250 g bell pepper, roasted from a jar, thickly sliced

steps: Trim any fat off the chicken thighs and cut each into 2-3 pieces.
Season the chicken and brown it on both sides in half the oil over high heat; lift it out.
Deglaze the hot pan with the sherry, scraping up the browned bits, and pour it into a jug.
Lower the heat a little, add the rest of the oil with the chorizo, onion and garlic, and cook until the onion turns translucent.
Return the sherry and chicken with the stock, chickpeas, peppers and seasoning; bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook gently about 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Finish with chopped parsley.

title: West African chicken peanut stew

ingredients.original_text: 2 sweet potato, medium, peeled and diced

ingredients.text: 300 g chicken thigh, skinless boneless, bite-sized pieces
ingredients.original_text: 600 g chicken thigh, skinless boneless, bite-sized pieces

steps: Soften the onion in half the oil for about 5 minutes, then add the sweet potato and pepper and cook 10 minutes more; set aside.
Whisk the peanut butter into the hot stock until smooth.
Cook the rice according to the packet.
Heat the remaining oil and fry the chicken with the garlic, ginger, ground coriander, cumin and chilli for about 5 minutes until golden.
Return the vegetables, pour in the peanut stock and simmer about 20 minutes until thick and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve over rice, scattered with coriander leaves and chopped peanuts.

title: Çılbır (Turkish eggs in garlic yogurt)

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp vinegar, cider or white wine
ingredients.original_text: 2 tbsp vinegar, cider or white wine

ingredients.text: 1 tsp parsley, or dill, finely chopped
ingredients.original_text: 1 tsp parsley, or dill, finely chopped

ingredients.text: 2 slice bread, flatbread or crusty bread
ingredients.original_text: 2 slice bread, flatbread or crusty bread

steps: Let the yogurt come to room temperature (take it out about 30 minutes ahead).
Crush the garlic with a pinch of salt into a paste, stir it through the yogurt and spread it over two plates.
Bring a small pan of salted water with the vinegar to the boil.
Swirl the water, slip in one egg and poach 2-3 minutes until the white sets but the yolk stays runny; repeat with the second.
Meanwhile warm the olive oil over low-medium heat, add the pul biber, let it infuse about 30 seconds and take off the heat.
Drain the eggs on kitchen paper, set them on the yogurt, spoon over the chilli oil, salt and scatter with herbs.
Serve straight away with bread.

title: Adjaruli Khachapuri

ingredients.text: 85 g flour, all-purpose, plus extra for dusting
ingredients.original_text: 170 g flour, all-purpose (1 1/3 cups), plus extra for dusting

ingredients.text: 0.5 tbsp olive oil, plus extra for greasing
ingredients.original_text: 1 tbsp olive oil, plus extra for greasing

steps: Put a pizza stone in the middle of the oven and heat to 260°C (500°F); oil a large bowl.
Mix yeast, sugar, oil, about 80 ml lukewarm water, flour and salt with a dough hook: 2-3 minutes on low, then 3-4 minutes on medium-low, until smooth and slightly wet.
Place in the oiled bowl, cover and leave somewhere warm 50-60 minutes until nearly doubled.
Mix the mozzarella and feta; crack the egg into a small cup, keeping the yolk whole.
Shape the dough into a ball, cover loosely and rest 15 minutes.

On floured baking paper, roll to a 25 cm round about 3 mm thick, spread with half the cheese leaving a small border, roll two opposite sides inward and pinch and twist the ends into a boat; fill the centre with the remaining cheese.
Leave uncovered 15 minutes to puff slightly, brush the edges with oil and slide onto the hot stone.
Bake 14-16 minutes until lightly golden and melted, pour the egg into the centre and bake 3-4 minutes more until the white just sets.
Dot with butter and serve hot, stirring egg and butter into the cheese at the table.

title: Canadian Poutine

ingredients.text: 15 g gravy mix, brown, about 1/2 packet

steps: Prepare the gravy according to the packet instructions and keep it hot over low heat.
Deep-fry the fries in oil at 350°F (175°C) until golden and crisp.
Drain the fries on a tray lined with paper towels.
Pile the fries onto plates, scatter the cheese curds on top and ladle over the hot gravy.
Eat straight away while the curds are just starting to melt.

title: Croque-monsieur maison
steps: Fondre le beurre dans une casserole, ajouter la farine, puis verser le lait petit à petit en fouettant pour obtenir une béchamel lisse.
Laisser épaissir, assaisonner de sel, poivre et muscade, puis retirer du feu.
Faire fondre la moitié de l'emmental dans la béchamel chaude.
Beurrer une face de chaque tranche de pain ; sur la face non beurrée de la moitié des tranches, étaler un peu de béchamel, poser le jambon et un peu de fromage, puis refermer.
Dorer les sandwichs à la poêle 3 à 4 min de chaque côté.
Les poser sur une plaque recouverte de papier cuisson, napper du reste de béchamel et parsemer du fromage restant.
Passer sous le gril environ 5 min jusqu'à ce que le dessus soit gratiné, et servir aussitôt avec une salade.

title: Fish and Chips

ingredients.original_text: 2 tbsp vegetable oil, a good splash

steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the potatoes, skin on, into chunky chips.
Parboil the chips for 2-3 minutes, drain well and let them steam dry.
Toss them with the vegetable oil in a roasting tin and roast 25-30 minutes, turning once, until golden.
About 15 minutes before the chips are ready, heat the olive oil in a large heavy frying pan and dust the cod with flour.
Fry the cod skin-side down for 4-5 minutes, turn and cook 5-6 minutes more until just flaking (finish very thick pieces in the oven for 5 minutes); move to warm plates.
In the same pan, sizzle the gherkins and capers for 1 minute, add the lemon juice and bubble 30 seconds on high, then take off the heat and stir in the herbs.
Top each fillet with a spoon of mayonnaise and the caper mixture, and serve with the chips.

title: Korean Fried Chicken (Yangnyeom-tongdak)

ingredients.text: 1.5 tsp vegetable oil, for the sauce
ingredients.original_text: 2 tsp vegetable oil, for the sauce

steps: Heat about 5 cm of oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat for 10-12 minutes until it reaches 165-175°C; a test piece of chicken should bubble immediately.
In a large bowl, mix the wings by hand with salt, pepper, starch, flour, baking soda and eggs until evenly coated.
Add the chicken to the oil piece by piece (in batches if needed) and fry about 12 minutes, turning, until golden and crunchy.
Lift the wings onto a wire strainer set over a bowl to drain.

For the sauce, heat the oil in a large skillet, fry the garlic about 30 seconds until lightly golden, stir in ketchup, rice syrup, gochujang and vinegar, then simmer on low until bubbling and take off the heat.
Let the frying oil come back to temperature (about 2 minutes) and fry the wings a second time for about 12 minutes until extra crunchy.
Bring the sauce back to a bubble over medium-high heat, add the hot wings and toss until glossy.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve, ideally with pickled radish.

title: Lasagne verdi alla bolognese

ingredients.text: 90 g farina, semola rimacinata di grano duro
ingredients.original_text: 350 g farina, semola rimacinata di grano duro

ingredients.text: 500 ml pomodori pelati, San Marzano passati
ingredients.original_text: 2 l pomodori pelati, San Marzano passati

steps: Scaldare olio e burro in una casseruola e rosolare il macinato a fiamma bassa per circa 10 minuti.
Alzare il fuoco, bagnare con il vino bianco e lasciarlo evaporare del tutto.
Unire i pelati passati e il basilico, poi cuocere circa 1 ora e mezza con il coperchio appoggiato.
Intanto cuocere gli spinaci in pentola coperta per 5 minuti senza condimento, scolarli, farli raffreddare e strizzarli bene in un canovaccio.
Frullare gli spinaci, aggiungere le due farine, l'uovo, il tuorlo e un pizzico di sale e impastare; avvolgere nella pellicola e far riposare 30 minuti.
Per la besciamella sciogliere il burro, tostare la farina fino a un roux dorato, poi versare il latte caldo in più riprese mescolando; salare e profumare con la noce moscata.
Stendere la pasta sottilissima (circa mezzo millimetro) e tagliarla a rettangoli.
Sbollentare le sfoglie 30 secondi in acqua salata con un filo d'olio, raffreddarle in acqua fredda e asciugarle su un canovaccio.
In una teglia imburrata alternare sfoglia, besciamella, ragù e parmigiano per 5 strati, chiudendo con besciamella e parmigiano.
Cuocere in forno già caldo a 170 °C per 40 minuti.

title: Parmigiana di melanzane in padella
steps: Lavare le melanzane, eliminare il picciolo e tagliarle a fette.
Disporle in uno scolapasta, cospargerle di sale e lasciarle spurgare per circa 1 ora.
Nel frattempo scaldare un cucchiaio d'olio con la passata e un po' d'acqua, salare e cuocere a fuoco basso 10 minuti; aggiungere il basilico e spegnere.
Sciacquare le melanzane e strizzarle delicatamente.
Grigliarle poche alla volta su una piastra antiaderente appena unta finché sono morbide e segnate.
In una padella antiaderente da 24 cm alternare strati di melanzane, sugo, parmigiano e mozzarella fino a esaurire gli ingredienti.
Coprire e cuocere a fuoco medio-basso per 20-25 minuti finché la mozzarella è fusa.

title: Prawn Okonomiyaki

ingredients.text: 300 g cabbage, white or pointed, finely shredded
ingredients.original_text: 300 g cabbage, white or pointed, finely shredded

ingredients.text: 3 tbsp worcestershire sauce, for the sauce
ingredients.original_text: 3 tbsp worcestershire sauce, for the sauce

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp oyster sauce, for the sauce
ingredients.original_text: 2 tbsp oyster sauce, for the sauce

steps: Whisk together ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce and sugar to make the okonomiyaki sauce.
Combine flour, baking powder and salt in a large bowl, beat in the stock and eggs, then fold in the cabbage and most of the spring onions.
Heat half the oil in a nonstick pan with a lid over medium heat and spoon in half the batter as a thick round about 15 cm wide; don't press it down.
Push half the prawns into the top, cover and cook 3-5 minutes until set and golden underneath.
Flip, cover again and cook another 3-5 minutes until golden and cooked through; give each side an extra minute if needed.
Slide onto a plate, drizzle with mayonnaise and sauce, scatter with spring onions and serve with pickled ginger.
Repeat with the remaining oil, batter and prawns for the second pancake.

title: Rösti with Fried Eggs
steps: Coarsely grate the potatoes, either raw or cooked and cooled.
Finely dice half the onion and mix it into the potatoes, seasoning if you like.
Melt butter in a large pan over high heat, add the potato mixture and stir a few minutes until warmed through.
Turn the heat to medium-high and press the mixture into a flat round cake about 1-1.5 cm thick.
Slip a little extra butter around the edge and cook 5-10 minutes until a crust forms underneath.
Meanwhile, dice the remaining onion and the carrot and steam them with the peas (or spinach) in a little water under a lid.
Flip the rösti onto a plate, slide it back into the pan and cook on medium-low until crisp on the second side.
Remove the rösti, fry the eggs in the same pan and serve them on top with the vegetables alongside.

title: Tartiflette traditionnelle

ingredients.text: 100 g lardons, poitrine fumée en dés
ingredients.original_text: 300 g lardons, poitrine fumée en dés

steps: Faire revenir l'oignon émincé et l'ail haché dans un filet d'huile jusqu'à ce qu'ils deviennent translucides, puis réserver.
Dorer les lardons dans la même poêle, remettre oignon et ail, puis déglacer au vin blanc.
Laisser le vin s'évaporer complètement, verser dans un bol et incorporer la crème, le sel, le poivre et la muscade.
Mettre les pommes de terre épluchées dans l'eau froide salée et les cuire environ 15 min : elles doivent rester un peu fermes.
Couper les pommes de terre en fines rondelles.
Frotter un plat à gratin beurré avec de l'ail, puis alterner couches de pommes de terre et de mélange aux lardons.
Gratter la croûte du reblochon, le couper en morceaux et le poser croûte vers le haut sur le dessus.
Enfourner à 180 °C pour 30 à 35 min, jusqu'à ce que le fromage soit fondu et doré, et servir bien chaud.

title: Halal-cart chicken over rice
steps: Toss the chicken with cumin, ground coriander, oregano, half the turmeric, 1 garlic clove, the juice of half the lemon, 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper. Leave 10 min.
Rinse the rice. Fry it 1 min in a little oil with the rest of the turmeric, add the stock, cover and simmer 12 min; rest 5 min off the heat.
Meanwhile, cook the chicken in a hot pan with a little oil, 5-6 min per side until charred and cooked through. Rest, then chop into bite-size pieces.
Mix the yogurt, mayonnaise, vinegar, the remaining garlic, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper to make the white sauce.
Serve the rice topped with chicken, lettuce and tomato, drizzled with white sauce and hot sauce.

title: Gochujang salmon rice bowl

ingredients.text: 250 g salmon fillet (2 fillets), skin off, cubed

steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Toss the cucumber with the rice vinegar, a pinch of salt and a pinch of sugar; set aside to quick-pickle.
Mix gochujang, soy sauce, honey and sesame oil. Toss the salmon in half of it.
Cook the edamame in boiling water for 3 min, then drain.
Sear the salmon in a hot pan with a little oil for 3-4 min, turning, then add the remaining glaze and toss 30 s until sticky.
Fill bowls with rice, salmon, cucumber, edamame and carrot. Top with spring onion and sesame seeds.

title: Pasta e ceci
steps: Gently fry the onion in 2 tbsp olive oil for 5 min. Add garlic, rosemary and chilli for 1 min, then stir in the tomato paste.
Add the chickpeas and stock and simmer 10 min. Remove the rosemary and mash or blend about a third of the chickpeas to thicken.
Add the pasta and cook in the soup, stirring often, until al dente (add a splash of water if it gets too thick).
Season, then serve with Parmesan, black pepper and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Poulet basquaise

ingredients.text: 60 g Bayonne ham or prosciutto, chopped
1 tsp piment d'Espelette or sweet paprika

steps: Season the chicken and brown it skin-side down in a little oil in a casserole, 6-7 min, then turn for 2 min. Set aside.
In the same pot, cook the onion, peppers and ham for 8 min until soft. Add the garlic and Espelette for 1 min.
Deglaze with the wine, then add the tomatoes, bay and thyme. Return the chicken, skin up.
Cover and simmer gently 25 min, then uncover for the last 5 min to thicken the sauce.
Meanwhile, cook the rice. Serve the chicken and peppers over rice.

title: Chicken shawarma traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C. Mix the spices, 2 garlic cloves, the juice of half the lemon, 2 tbsp oil and salt.
Toss the chicken and onion wedges in the marinade and spread on a tray in one layer.
Roast 25-30 min until the chicken is charred at the edges. Rest 5 min, then slice.
Mix the yogurt with the remaining garlic, a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Toss tomato, cucumber and parsley with lemon juice and oil. Serve the chicken and onions with flatbreads, garlic yogurt and salad.

title: Turkey taco lettuce wraps

ingredients.text: 1 tsp chili powder, chipotle (or 1 chipotle in adobo, chopped)
1 little gem or romaine lettuce, leaves separated

steps: Cook the onion in 1 tsp oil for 3 min. Add the turkey and brown, breaking it up, 5-6 min.
Stir in garlic, chipotle, cumin, paprika and tomato paste for 1 min, then add the beans and a splash of water. Simmer 2 min until saucy.
Season with salt and the juice of half the lime.
Spoon the filling into lettuce cups and top with tomato, avocado, yogurt, coriander and lime wedges.

title: Chana masala

ingredients.text: 1 chili flakes, fresh green chilli, chopped

steps: Start the rice according to the packet.
Heat 2 tbsp oil and sizzle the cumin seeds for 30 s. Add the onion and cook 8 min until golden.
Add garlic, ginger and chilli for 1 min, then the ground spices for 30 s.
Add the tomatoes and cook 5 min until thick, then the chickpeas and 150 ml water. Simmer 10 min, lightly crushing some chickpeas.
Season with salt and lemon juice, scatter with coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Chicken teriyaki donburi

ingredients.text: 400 g chicken thigh, boneless, skin on

steps: Cook the rice. Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 3-4 min.
Cook the chicken skin-side down in a little oil over medium heat for 7 min until crisp, then turn and cook 4 min more.
Wipe out excess fat, pour in the sauce and simmer 1-2 min, turning the chicken until glossy.
Slice the chicken and serve over rice with broccoli, extra sauce, spring onion and sesame.

title: Shakshuka with feta
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in 2 tbsp olive oil for 8 min until soft.
Add garlic and spices for 1 min, then the tomatoes. Simmer 6-8 min until thick; season.
Make 5 wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook on low for 5-7 min until the whites are set and yolks still runny.
Scatter with feta and parsley and serve straight from the pan with bread.

title: Beef & broccoli stir-fry

ingredients.text: 350 g flank or rump steak, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Cook the rice. Toss the beef with 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Mix the sauce: 2 tbsp soy, oyster sauce, sugar, sesame oil, 1 tsp cornflour and 80 ml water.
Heat a wok until smoking, add 1 tbsp oil and sear the beef in one layer, 1-2 min, without overcooking. Remove.
Add a little oil, the broccoli and 2 tbsp water; stir-fry 3 min until bright and just tender. Add garlic and ginger for 30 s.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce and toss 1 min until glossy. Serve over rice.
